title: Class-II source, translated model, balanced coefficient jets, and obstruction boundary
statement: A13-CLASSII-SPARSE-PRODUCTION-OWNER-RADIAL-GRAM-GLOBAL-BOUNDARY (R-166 v1.1) proves, on the fixed side-16 exact nonaliased R-153 p:2p strict-past / single fresh-4p twelve-dimensional conditional fibre with unit retained regulator multipliers and positive floor, the global owner bound K_owner(g)[alpha,alpha] >= P_tilde(G)|alpha|^2 > -4|alpha|^2/5 for every whitened past amplitude G>=0. The unchanged exact rational certificate permits the scoped R-164 choice rho=3/20, with full semiconvexity 31/220 and epsilon_v=367/880. Exact two-harmonic Fourier arithmetic also proves that the coefficient-one direct source-coordinate lemma does not tensorize to simultaneous fresh-4p and fresh-8p support: the generalized Gram is [[5/4,1],[1,3/2]] and the rational direction (1,-1) has ratio 3/8. The complete joint cross-root owner, random/nonlinear/revisit feedback, shifted low variables, removal, T-050/A13, phase/PDE/morphology, Nelson/measure, and Sector-A closure remain open.
